Manipur: Naga Group Issues Ultimatum After Civilian Killings

A Naga group has issued a three-day ultimatum to the Union and Manipur state governments following the killing of four civilians. The killings led to a 24-hour shutdown in Manipur, which affected normal life. Separately, after 187 days, families received the bodies of six Naga men for burial.
